headline.not_a_claim: This is not a whole-repository proof of absence of defects. SDK liveness, outstanding current-image tests, performance and physical qualification are listed separately.

After an acceptable short screen, run the requested current-image 600-second and 32-configuration USB+BLE suite.
Keep absolute accuracy and physical isolation claims conditional on independent electrical evidence.

open_items.impact: A stuck/full BTC work queue can keep BLE_TX inside the public SDK call beyond the application retry deadline. The same owner cannot then drain later DATA or CTRL. This prevents claiming a finite end-to-end BLE transaction deadline.

ESP-IDF components/bt/common/osi/include/osi/thread.h:56 documents maximum timeout as blocking forever
open_items.already_correct: No application s_bleMux is held across the SDK call. The packet/slot remains owned; sdkCallActive, call start/completion, errors and wall time are exposed. Accepted indications are not blindly resent.
open_items.minimal_next_step: Add one deterministic SDK-stall test at this single call boundary. Hold SDK return while verifying USB query progress, acquisition progress and unchanged slot ownership; observe active age and the chosen finite quarantine/restart response. If strict finite completion is required, design that response outside the stalled BLE owner using the existing guarded restart/budget path. Do not delete the task, recycle its slot, patch the SDK or label a timeout as cancellation.
open_items.test_kind: Synthetic failure-containment test first; current hardware recordings do not show a stuck call.
open_items.blocks: Unqualified claim that every BLE operation, including the SDK call, always returns within the application deadline.

open_items.interpretation: Measured service loss remains; this is not by itself a P0/P1 safety defect. FIFO/SDK acceptance and CONF are not PC receipt. Layer windows differ and cannot be added or subtracted into an air-loss attribution. SDK wall time minus role runtime is not measured blocked time.

Use its measured outcome to choose the next narrow change; do not infer throughput from SPI MHz or impose a permanent capture cap.

main/main.c:658 sensorarrayBootPrepareRestart keeps a finite restart chain

open_items.interpretation: Current idle watchdog and restart bookkeeping must not be described as a complete acquisition-progress monitor. SPI/FDC no-cancel limitations are contained by ownership/quarantine, not proof of physical cancellation. Host regressions already test modeled deadlines; real bus-stall/control responsiveness and all-frontends power return remain unverified.
open_items.minimal_next_step: Use a nonphysical fault-injection build to hold one accepted SPI/FDC result and separately suppress scan progress while the task yields. Check finite caller completion or quarantine, no reuse of pending objects, queryable state and finite restart budget. Include legitimate PAUSED/SAFE/slow modes so no universal short frame timeout is introduced. Do not disconnect powered analog supplies or inject dangerous bus faults unattended.
open_items.blocks: A universal recovery claim, not the already demonstrated normal short-screen behavior.

source_evidence: docs/hardware/reliability_revision_notes.md:39 external rail path and precision limitations
docs/hardware/reliability_revision_notes.md:52 R38-R45 input loading and :54 real disconnect requirement
known_limits: U5 common REF remains connected; Q1 is a shunt clamp, not verified analog isolation. Software/GPIO agreement cannot close power-loss/reference hazards.
VOLT loading through the approximately 10 kohm negative-rail network depends on external source impedance and cannot be removed by a fixed offset.
External rail values are temporary RAM settings with unknown traceable uncertainty; span is not two independent supply measurements.
The authorized floating-point CAP background proxy is reproducible but is not a same-point open baseline or a 33 pF precision certification.
HW01-HW06 as-built electrical measurements/rework, power-transient/backfeed checks and physical SCLK/DOUT/CS waveforms remain NOT_RUN.
open_items.minimal_next_step: Retain the current restricted capability declarations. For precision acceptance, first record independent ADS-pin rail measurements and uncertainty plus the known fixture tolerances; evaluate both resistors and all three declared CAP proxy models without selecting the closest result. For transparent internal monitoring or arbitrary external sources, obtain an actual fail-safe disconnect/high-impedance hardware path and qualified electrical measurements before enabling the capability.
open_items.adc_tail_limit: Three earlier 120-second windows with ADC CRC 0/79417, 0/76069 and 0/76128, plus STD 63/400 versus GPIO 0/400 at 2 MHz, support the software workaround. They do not uniquely establish a PCB/silicon cause or verify pad timing, analog accuracy, or STATUS integrity.

open_items.already_verified: The corrected CDC/BLE USBBOOT, guarded owner DMA shutdown, ROM/app path and same-MAC BUILD attestation have real successful evidence. Ordinary RTS-only exit failures remain historical; the verified ESP32-S3 watchdog exit helper is the operational path.
open_items.minimal_next_step: Keep the verified app-only flash/helper and full BUILD identity gate for ordinary recovery; do not repeat failed RTS toggling. A claim that physical BOOT/power access is never necessary requires separate fault testing of cases where neither CPU nor USB/BLE control can execute, which software alone cannot guarantee.
open_items.blocks: Absolute no-physical-recovery-ever claim, not ordinary software reflash acceptance.
